content: Vercel Functions (formerly Serverless Functions) use an /api directory at repo root; each file becomes an endpoint. Node.js runtime supports 20.x/22.x/24.x as of 2026, with 22.x the default for new projects (20.x deprecated Oct 1 2026). Functions use Web-standard Request/Response. No framework required for a Vite SPA - plain /api/*.js handlers work alongside static dist/ output automatically.
